fusions.name: Shod Ram
fusions.desc: Rams the steel-capped butt of the staff into the target. It deals 14 damage, leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds and knocks it back 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Rattle Their Plate
fusions.desc: A sweep of the banded staff that deals 3 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave its target [Sundered] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Hoops of Steel
fusions.desc: You hold the staff crosswise and its steel bands close into a barrier. It absorbs the next 24 damage, up to 6 blows, and holds for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Parry Rings True
fusions.desc: 12% of the damage you take is turned back off the staff into whoever dealt it. Your armour rises by 6%.
